content_html: UK Biobank features Dr. Fang and SMILE Lab's research showing that AI analysis of routine retinal photographs can reveal modifiable Alzheimer's disease risk factors, potentially enabling earlier intervention. [UK Biobank]

Our paper "Multi-Modal Contrastive Representation Learning for Preclinical AD Prediction" will be presented at the Biomedical Engineering Society (BMES) Annual Meeting, October 21–24, 2026, in Orlando, FL!

Our paper "Baseline Neuroimaging and Machine Learning Predict Pain Relief Following BAT-Paired tDCS in Knee Osteoarthritis" will be presented at the Biomedical Engineering Society (BMES) Annual Meeting, October 21–24, 2026, in Orlando, FL!
